written: 2026-10-08, while the four cleantest fine-tunes were training; before any TabICL job of step 10 ran
question: Does TabICL do better given the fine-tuned ESM-2's own last hidden state (64 PCs) than given the frozen ESM-2 PCs, or than given the fine-tuned score?
fold_models: cleantest_0..3 (run s2p_full_cleantest_20261008): the full recipe, CryptoBench train folds != k, LIGYSIS minus homologs of train fold k AND of test (ligysis_exclusions.json, union)
embedding: last hidden state (2560-d, fp16) of model k on train fold k + test chains; PCA(64, random_state=0) fit on fold-k chains only
table: build/residues_ftemb.parquet = residues_esm64.parquet + blocks ftk{k}_pc00..63, ftk{k}_score (scripts/ftemb_build_table.py; sha256 in step10_ftemb_table.json)
harness: deploy/ftemb_stack.py; tabicl 2.1.1, seed 0, budget 50k, sampling.build_context on the context rows
design: cross-fitted: a job with block k takes its context from train fold k and queries test; the test score of an arm is the mean of its four predictions k=0..3. Every arm, the control included, uses these same contexts.

arms.ft117: 53 structural/ensemble/conservation + 64 fine-tuned PCs in place of the frozen PCs (primary)

references.ft_alone: mean of the four fold models' own scores on test
references.tabicl_117: the published headline (context: all four folds)
references.s2pfull_117: step 9's stack (context: all four folds, out-of-fold score)

thresholds: per fold model k: out-of-fold scores of 4 protein sub-folds of fold k (sampling.protein_subfolds, seed 0), threshold at mean per-protein FPR 0.05; frozen = median over k; applied to the averaged test score. Threshold metrics are secondary: the averaged score's distribution differs from a single context's.
criterion: paired 95 % bootstrap CI (10,000 protein resamples, seed 0) of per-protein AUPRC on CB-full (231 proteins) excludes zero, above
expectation: a null on the primary is plausible: supervised ESM projections hurt before (RESULTS.md, PLS), and the score is one exact linear direction of this embedding that a 64-PC PCA may dilute
